info.name: Aaraksha Backend — Full API Test Suite
info.description: Complete automated test suite for the Aaraksha backend. 300 assertions across 133 requests in 24 folders (+ cleanup) covering the core API surface, auth flows, security guards, validation, edge cases, the unified Rescuer network (volunteer registration/verification/provisioning, combined team-or-volunteer SOS assignment, live rescuer location/status), the AI Travel Assistant (Build My Journey, natural-language intake, propose-then-apply trip adjustment, routes-between), and the simulated NTN satellite fallback. Run against http://localhost:5000.
